Each writer was a resident, worker or student in Napa County. Writers submitted one or two unpublished stories in either prose or poetry format, with a limit of 60 words per story. A winning story connected all elements together, showing creativity and originality!
Submissions were accepted in English from adults or youth age 18 or younger, or in Spanish from youth age 18 or younger.
Yountville Arts, Napa County Libraries and Friends of the Yountville Library sponsor this event. The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. item.title: Harvest Full Moon: Fall Equinox Ceremonial Sound Bath — Fri Sep 25, 7:00 PM — Church of the Nativity
item.description:
Join Journey Beyond Sound as we return to the beautiful Church of the Nativity sanctuary in the peaceful Lucas Valley hillsides. 🌕✨
Settle in for an immersive evening of guided meditation and live acoustic sounds inspired by the Autumn Equinox and Harvest Full Moon. Multiple musicians will create a soundscape with singing bowls gongs, flute, chimes, and more.
This is a welcoming space to relax, reflect, release the busy-ness of summer, and ground into the calm rhythm of fall. The evening includes seasonal tarot pulls and intention setting.
Bring a mat, blanket, and small pillow for comfort. Chairs are also available. Doors open at 6:40 pm; the sound journey begins at 7:00 pm.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
